CustomField.formula: IF( ISBLANK(Employment_Start_Date__c), "", TEXT( YEAR(TODAY()) - YEAR(Employment_Start_Date__c) - IF( DATE(YEAR(TODAY()), MONTH(Employment_Start_Date__c), DAY(Employment_Start_Date__c)) > TODAY(), 1, 0 ) ) & " years, " & TEXT( MOD( MONTH(TODAY()) - MONTH(Employment_Start_Date__c) - IF(DAY(TODAY()) < DAY(Employment_Start_Date__c), 1, 0) + 12, 12 ) ) & " months" )
CustomField.label: Length of Service
